notes: §1985:X.5.2.2 prints two CALL formats: CALL { identifier-1 | literal-1 } [ USING { [ BY REFERENCE ] { identifier-2 } ... | BY CONTENT { identifier-2 } ... } ... ] followed by [ ON OVERFLOW imperative-statement-1 ] (Format 1) or [ ON EXCEPTION ... ] [ NOT ON EXCEPTION ... ] (Format 2), then [ END-CALL ]. callStatement/callArgument parse the superset; ConditionalPhraseAssociation.Associates admits ON OVERFLOW at 85 (VisitCallStatement gates it only from 2023) and refuses NOT ON OVERFLOW and OVERFLOW beside EXCEPTION (COBOL2269); OutOfPrintedOrder via VisitConditionalPhrases refuses NOT ON EXCEPTION before ON EXCEPTION (COBOL0900); CallBinder.Format1Narrowing/Format2OnlySpellingOf refuse every non-identifier argument at 85 (BY CONTENT literal, ZERO, ALL literal, a bare literal, an expression: COBOL0900; BY VALUE, OMITTED: COBOL0900), and VisitCallStatement refuses RETURNING (COBOL0884) and AS (COBOL0900). Probes at 85: Format 1 and Format 2 run (NOEXC ZZZ by reference; BY CONTENT leaves the caller's item; OVF-M and EXC-M on a missing program, NOT ON EXCEPTION skipped); (a) a ref-modified, a subscripted and an OCCURS DEPENDING ON group argument pass; (b) empty USING, missing target, a doubled ON EXCEPTION, a numeric literal target (COBOL1627) and a numeric identifier-1 (COBOL1681) are refused; (f) an 18-digit BY REFERENCE item round-trips. BY CONTENT FUNCTION UPPER-CASE(WS-A) compiles; Amendment 1's §1985:X.5.2.3 SR4 forbids it, a syntax-rule defect owned by kb/Work PB5129, not this format. The witness refuses CALL USING "ABC" (COBOL0900).

next.reason: 1985: "║ [ ON OVERFLOW imperative-statement-1 ] ║ ... [ ON EXCEPTION imperative-statement-1 ] [ NOT ON EXCEPTION imperative-statement-2 ]"; 2023: "[ RETURNING identifier-3 ] ┌ │ ON EXCEPTION imperative-statement-1 │ ... │ NOT ON EXCEPTION imperative-statement-2 │ ┘ (choice indicators, any order)". The CALL format is kept, but ON OVERFLOW is gone, so such CALLs are now refused. ON EXCEPTION and NOT ON EXCEPTION may appear in any order, and RETURNING and a prototype format are added.
